AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

2. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Producers
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Decomposers only

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil Erosion Control? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil Erosion Control.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil Erosion Control.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil Erosion Control.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Soil Erosion Control.

5. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Forage Crops? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Forage Crops.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Forage Crops.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forage Crops.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Forage Crops.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agricultural Biotechnology? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agricultural Biotechnology.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agricultural Biotechnology.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Agricultural Biotechnology.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agricultural Biotechnology.

9. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Livestock Nutrition? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Nutrition.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Livestock Nutrition.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Livestock Nutrition.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Livestock Nutrition.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Urban and peri-urban Agriculture? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Urban and peri-urban Agriculture.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Urban and peri-urban Agriculture.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Urban and peri-urban Agriculture.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Urban and peri-urban Agriculture.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Disease control? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Disease control.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Disease control.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Disease control.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Disease control.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animal Health: Disease Control? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animal Health: Disease Control.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animal Health: Disease Control.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Health: Disease Control.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animal Health: Disease Control.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Powered Agricultural Implements? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Powered Agricultural Implements.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Powered Agricultural Implements.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Powered Agricultural Implements.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Powered Agricultural Implements.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animal Breeding? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animal Breeding.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Breeding.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Animal Breeding.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animal Breeding.

16. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Urban and peri-urban Agriculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Powered Agricultural Implements and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Agricultural Biotechnology and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Agri- business Accounts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Business and Career Opportunities in Agriculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
